name: All staff MUST complete Security Awareness training annually because staff are the best defence against human error.
conditionsText: All staff are required to complete the training
requirementTitle: All staff MUST complete Security Awareness training annually because staff are the best defence against human error.
requirementDescription: Every employee must complete security awareness training at least once a year so they understand common cyber risks and know how to avoid causing or contributing to security incidents.
why: Many security incidents involve human actions rather than technical failures.
tasks: All staff MUST complete Security Awareness training annually because staff are the best defence against human error.

actions.title: All staff MUST complete Security Awareness training annually because staff are the best defence against human error.
actions.description: Everyone must complete cyber security awareness training every year so they can recognise threats, handle information safely, and help prevent incidents caused by mistakes or social engineering attacks.
